ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and flag the driver's account for misuse of the "I'm Here" button/abusive cancellation fee practice. + flag_account

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement [F12] and chat [F9] claim he was at the pickup and waited >3 min, but GPS/timeline records show he never entered the 200 m pickup radius (closest 288 m [F1], stationary 350 m away [F2], never recorded arrived [F4], 0 s within 200 m after tapping [F5]). System records override statements, so NS-1 (ii) fails.
Requires an upheld route-deviation/detour finding with a refund >0 in this case; this is a no-show dispute with no off-route segments, so the repeated-offence account flag under RD-6 does not apply.
